tasks.label: Build: RogueSquadron64Recomp (Debug)
tasks.detail: Full relink of the game exe (tested config).

tasks.label: Build: RogueSquadron64Recomp (Release)
tasks.detail: Release exe. POST_BUILD assembles a clean build/dist/ with just the exe + DLLs + menu json. Needs a ClangCL cache: cmake -B build -T ClangCL. Copy rogue_squadron.z64 next to the exe to run.

tasks.label: Configure (Windows x86)
tasks.detail: 32-bit Windows tree in build-x86. Reuses the x64 build's N64Recomp.exe, so build the x64 Debug target first.

tasks.label: Configure (Linux)
tasks.detail: Native Linux tree in build/ with the Windows layout (build/Debug, build/Release), so the shared Build, Run and Test tasks work. Needs the README's Linux packages and steps 1-3.

tasks.label: Build: RogueSquadron64Recomp (x86 Debug)
tasks.detail: 32-bit Windows exe in build-x86/Debug. Copy rogue_squadron.z64 next to it to run.

tasks.label: Build: RogueSquadron64Recomp (x86 Release)
tasks.detail: 32-bit Windows Release; assembles build-x86/dist/.

tasks.label: Package: Bump version
tasks.detail: Raises the release version in VERSION (read by CMake, Gradle and the packaging scripts). For an exact number, edit VERSION or run tools/release/bump-version.ps1 -Set 1.2.3.

tasks.label: Package: Release bundle (all platforms)
tasks.detail: Builds Release for the chosen targets (Windows x64/x86, Linux x64/arm64/armhf/i386 through WSL, Android) and writes the zips, tarballs, AppImages, Flatpaks and APK to <folder>/v<VERSION>/ (default: your Desktop). Windows zips are staged fresh, so ROMs and saves in build*/dist never ship. Prints a table of what was built.

tasks.label: Package: RecompModTool (Windows + Linux)
tasks.detail: Builds RecompModTool from the N64Recomp fork (Windows x64 here, Linux x64 through WSL) and writes RecompModTool-<platform>-modtool-<commit>.zip/.tar.gz plus SHA256SUMS.txt to <folder>/modtool-<commit>/.

tasks.label: Run: Game (pick level / craft)
tasks.detail: Launch the game with an optional forced level and/or craft (--force-level / --force-craft). You drive the menus; whatever mission you launch uses the forced values.

tasks.label: Build: Relay server
tasks.detail: Builds rs64_relay (the co-op relay server, relay-server/) into build/<config>.

tasks.label: Run: Relay server
tasks.detail: Builds rs64_relay, then opens it in its own console window on UDP 27070, run from build/<config> (its rs64_relay.cfg is saved there). Type help in that window for commands; quit or Ctrl+C stops it. Point the game at it with "relay_server": "127.0.0.1" in roguesq_net.json (docs/guides/relay-server.md).

tasks.label: Record: Input recording (pick level / craft)
tasks.detail: Record controller input into tools/debug/recordings/<id>-<mission>/ (folder created if missing). Mission = lockstep .rec + .hash baseline, boots straight into the level; session = from launch with the level forced. Blank name = <mission>_<timestamp>.

tasks.label: Record: Co-op client recording (you fly player 2)
tasks.detail: Online co-op pair on localhost: the host (left) replays the level's solo recording (newest <mission>_<timestamp>.rec unless overridden), you fly the client (right) and your input is saved as <mission>_coop_client_<timestamp>.rec. Close the client window to stop. Craft None = the host recording's craft.

tasks.label: IDE: Refresh clangd compile database
tasks.command: $vs = 'C:/Program Files/Microsoft Visual Studio/2022/Community'; Import-Module "$vs/Common7/Tools/Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll"; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vs -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64' | Out-Null; cmake -S . -B build-ide -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-cl -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang-cl -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
tasks.detail: Configure-only Ninja tree (build-ide/) that writes compile_commands.json for clangd. Never built; rerun after adding source files or changing CMakeLists. Generated RT64 shader headers come from build/src via .clangd.

tasks.label: IDE: Refresh Android clangd compile database
tasks.command: $src = Get-ChildItem android/app/.cxx -Recurse -Filter compile_commands.json | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '[\\/]tools[\\/]' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $src) { Write-Host 'No Android compile database yet: run an Android build first.'; exit 1 }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force build-ide-android | Out-Null; Copy-Item $src.FullName build-ide-android/compile_commands.json -Force; Write-Host "Copied $($src.FullName)"
tasks.detail: Copies the newest NDK compile_commands.json from android/app/.cxx (its folder name is a hash that changes) to build-ide-android/, which .clangd uses for android_host.cpp.

tasks.label: Build: All mods
tasks.detail: Builds every native mod (mods/<name>/CMakeLists.txt) separately from the game; each DLL lands beside its mod.json and the next game build copies mods/ next to the exe.

tasks.label: Regen: Recompiled Functions (funcs_*.c)
tasks.detail: Regenerate RecompiledFuncs/ from rogue_squadron.toml (rebuilds N64RecompCLI first, reads ../rogue_squadron64/build/roguesquadron.elf, verifies the co-op relocation patches).

tasks.label: Regen + Build: Recompiled Functions
tasks.detail: Regenerate funcs_*.c then compile the RecompiledFuncs target.

tasks.label: Test: Unit tests
tasks.detail: Builds and runs rs64_unit_tests: lockstep_core, mp_core, net_core, net_link, nav_target, host_api, cable_alias, crosshair_match, rs64_lights, then the style checker.

tasks.label: Test: Unit tests (standalone, no game build)
tasks.command: cmake -S tests -B build-tests; if ($?) { cmake --build build-tests --config ${input:rsConfig} --target rs64_unit_tests }

linux.command: cmake -S tests -B build-tests -G 'Ninja Multi-Config' && cmake --build build-tests --config ${input:rsConfig} --target rs64_unit_tests

tasks.detail: Runs rs64_unit_tests from its own tree in build-tests: needs only the submodules, no ROM, recompiled code or MIPS toolchain.

tasks.label: Test: Standalone test
tasks.detail: Builds and runs one of the EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL tests that rs64_unit_tests does not cover.

tasks.label: Configure (Linux/WSL)
tasks.detail: Configure a Linux build in the selected WSL distro. Build tree lives on the distro's ext4 home ($HOME/rs64-build); source stays on the Windows drive. Uses Ninja + the distro's default gcc/clang. The pre-generated RecompiledFuncs/ucode are reused.

tasks.label: Build (Linux/WSL): RogueSquadron64Recomp
tasks.detail: Configure then build the native Linux exe in the selected WSL distro. Output: ~/rs64-build/RogueSquadron64Recomp (ELF x86-64). Requires: build-essential cmake ninja-build libsdl2-dev libvulkan-dev libgtk-3-dev python3 zip gcc-mips-linux-gnu binutils-mips-linux-gnu (configure with -DMIPS_GCC=/usr/bin/mips-linux-gnu-gcc -DMIPS_LD=/usr/bin/mips-linux-gnu-ld).

tasks.label: Configure (Linux/WSL, Release)
tasks.detail: Configure a Linux Release build in the selected WSL distro. Separate build tree ($HOME/rs64-build-release) so it does not clobber the Debug one. Ninja + the distro's default gcc/clang; pre-generated RecompiledFuncs/ucode reused.

tasks.label: Build (Linux/WSL, Release): RogueSquadron64Recomp
tasks.detail: Configure then build the native Linux Release exe in the selected WSL distro. Output: ~/rs64-build-release/RogueSquadron64Recomp (ELF x86-64). Requires: build-essential cmake ninja-build libsdl2-dev libvulkan-dev libgtk-3-dev python3 zip gcc-mips-linux-gnu binutils-mips-linux-gnu (configure with -DMIPS_GCC=/usr/bin/mips-linux-gnu-gcc -DMIPS_LD=/usr/bin/mips-linux-gnu-ld).

tasks.label: Test (WSL): Unit tests
args: cd "$(wslpath '${workspaceFolder}')" && d="$HOME/${input:wslBuildDir}" && if [ ! -d "$d" ]; then echo "No build tree at $d: run the matching Configure (Linux/WSL) task first."; exit 1; fi && cmake --build "$d" --target rs64_unit_tests -j"$(nproc)"
tasks.detail: Builds and runs rs64_unit_tests in the selected WSL distro's Linux build tree (unit tests + style checker).

tasks.label: Test (WSL): Standalone test
args: cd "$(wslpath '${workspaceFolder}')" && d="$HOME/${input:wslBuildDir}" && if [ ! -d "$d" ]; then echo "No build tree at $d: run the matching Configure (Linux/WSL) task first."; exit 1; fi && cmake --build "$d" --target ${input:wslTest} -j"$(nproc)" && "$d/${input:wslTest}"
tasks.detail: Builds and runs one EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL test in the WSL Linux build tree, including the POSIX-only fault_guard_test.

tasks.label: Package (Linux/WSL, Release bundle)
tasks.detail: Build then package the Release exe into a stripped self-contained bundle (exe + app libs + run.sh launcher) at ~/rs64-linux-release.tar.xz. Excludes glibc core, the Vulkan loader, and the ROM (all host-provided). tools/release/package-linux.sh takes an output path arg; point it at /mnt/c/... to drop straight on Windows.

tasks.label: Test: Linux remotes (Raspberry Pi)
tasks.detail: For every machine in ~/.config/rs64/remotes (WSL; lines '<name> <user>@<host> <remote-dir>'): detects arch/OS/glibc/Vulkan, deploys the matching RogueSquadron64Recomp-linux-<arch>-*.tar.xz, copies the ROM, runs --help and a headless boot in the logged-in desktop session, and pulls the logs back to logs/platform-tests/.

tasks.label: Linux: Copy build out of WSL
tasks.detail: Packages a WSL build tree (x64 or arm64, detected) into <folder>/rs64-linux-<arch>.tar.xz: exe, libs, run.sh and mods. A tarball keeps the execute bits a copy through a Windows folder loses.

tasks.label: Linux: Deploy build to remote machine
tasks.detail: Streams a rs64-linux-<arch>.tar.xz (or an .AppImage/other file) to user@host over one ssh connection and unpacks it into the remote folder. ssh asks for the password in this terminal unless a key is set up.

tasks.label: Linux: Copy ROM to remote machine
tasks.detail: Copies the ROM into the remote folder next to run.sh. ssh asks for the password in this terminal unless a key is set up.

tasks.label: Build (Linux cross, WSL): tarball + AppImage
tasks.detail: arm64 (Raspberry Pi 64-bit OS), armhf (32-bit Pi OS, Pi 2+) or i386. Cross-compiles into ~/rs64-build-<arch>-release (build-time tools run under qemu-user), then writes the tarball, AppImage and, for arm64, Flatpak to build/release/. One-time packages: docs/guides/building-all-platforms.md.

tasks.label: Build (macOS cross, WSL/osxcross): RogueSquadron64Recomp
tasks.detail: macOS cross-build via osxcross (~/osxcross/target). Builds host tools and SDL2 on first run, then configures + builds into ~/rs64-build-macos-<arch> (Release: ~/rs64-build-macos-<arch>-release). Metal shaders compile with Apple's Metal Developer Tools for Windows (C:\Program Files\Metal Developer Tools, or METAL_TOOLS_DIR); without them the binary links but cannot render.

tasks.label: Package (macOS .app, WSL/osxcross)
args: set -e; R="$(wslpath '${workspaceFolder}')"; bash "$R/tools/release/macos/cross-build.sh" arm64 Release; bash "$R/tools/release/macos/cross-build.sh" x86_64 Release; mkdir -p "$R/build/release"; bash "$R/tools/release/macos/package.sh" "$R/build/release/RogueSquadron64Recomp-macos.zip" ~/rs64-build-macos-arm64-release ~/rs64-build-macos-x86_64-release
tasks.detail: Release cross-builds for arm64 and x86_64, then one universal RogueSquadron64Recomp.app zipped with README.txt and LICENSE.txt into build/release/RogueSquadron64Recomp-macos.zip.

tasks.label: Run (Linux/WSL, GPU via dzn)
tasks.detail: Launch the Linux build interactively under WSLg: GPU Vulkan via Mesa Dozen (dzn -> D3D12 -> real GPU) + sound via PulseAudio + keyboard input. Click the window to focus. Keys: Arrows/WASD=stick, W/Enter=A, Space=B, Escape=Start, E=R, F4=L. Requires a one-time Mesa dzn build in ~/mesa-dzn (see project memory). For a headless smoke test add: --fake-controller --auto-start 8000.

tasks.label: Build (Android): APK (Debug)
tasks.detail: Gradle + NDK arm64 build of libmain.so/libSDL2.so into android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/RogueSquadron64Recomp-debug.apk. Needs a prior Windows Debug build (generated RecompiledFuncs/ucode/state table + build/Debug/file_to_c.exe); CMake stops with a clear error if any are missing.

tasks.label: Install + Run (Android)
tasks.command: & "${env:LOCALAPPDATA}/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb.exe" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/RogueSquadron64Recomp-debug.apk; if ($?) { & "${env:LOCALAPPDATA}/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb.exe" shell am start -n com.rs64recomp.app/.MainActivity }
tasks.detail: Build, install over USB/wireless adb, and launch. First time: push the ROM with 'Push ROM (Android)'. Watch output with 'Logcat (Android)'.

tasks.label: Build (Android): APK (Release)
tasks.detail: Optimized native build (the Debug APK is -O0 and stutters). Signed with the debug key, so it installs over the Debug APK and keeps the pushed ROM.

tasks.label: Install + Run (Android, Release)
tasks.command: & "${env:LOCALAPPDATA}/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb.exe" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/RogueSquadron64Recomp-release.apk; if ($?) { & "${env:LOCALAPPDATA}/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb.exe" shell am start -n com.rs64recomp.app/.MainActivity }
tasks.detail: Build the Release APK, install it, and launch. Use this for performance testing.

tasks.label: Install (Android, Release)
tasks.detail: Build the Release APK and install it over USB/wireless adb without launching it.

tasks.label: Build + Install over USB (Android, Release)
tasks.command: $adb = '${env:LOCALAPPDATA}/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb.exe'; if ((& $adb -d get-state 2>$null) -ne 'device') { Write-Host 'No USB device found: plug the phone in, enable USB debugging, and accept the RSA prompt.'; exit 1 }; & $adb -d install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/RogueSquadron64Recomp-release.apk; if (-not $?) { exit 1 }; & $adb -d shell am start -n com.rs64recomp.app/.MainActivity
tasks.detail: Build the Release APK, install it on the phone connected over USB (adb -d, ignores wireless/emulator devices), and launch it.

tasks.label: Push ROM (Android)
tasks.detail: Copies build/Debug/rogue_squadron.z64 into the app's files dir. Env vars for the game go in roguesq_env.txt (NAME=VALUE per line) in the same dir.

tasks.label: Logcat (Android)
tasks.command: & "${env:LOCALAPPDATA}/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb.exe" logcat -v time RS64:V SDL:V DEBUG:V AndroidRuntime:E *:S
tasks.detail: Game stdout/stderr (tag RS64), SDL, and native crash tombstones (DEBUG).
